checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add note thinning for scores

impact_assessment.why: there is no way to reduce a dense run of notes to a minimum spacing without rewriting the score.
impact_assessment.benefits: thin keeps a sounding note only when it starts at least a gap after the previously kept note, preserving rests and all kept fields.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: gap positive finite, first note kept, spacing rule exact, rests preserved, round-trip, invalid values fail; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for thinning, rest preservation and round-trip, a CLI command with --gap, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 500 tests green; spacing rule, rest preservation and round-trip pinned by byte tests
Task 'coda-thin' completed successfully.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add a note-tie transform

impact_assessment.why: there is no way to merge consecutive notes of the same pitch into one sustained note without rewriting the score.
impact_assessment.benefits: ties merges adjacent equal-pitch notes that touch, keeping the first note's fields and extending its duration to the last one's end.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: only touching equal-pitch sounding notes merge, first fields kept, duration sums correctly, other notes unchanged, round-trip; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for merging, non-merging cases and round-trip, a CLI command, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 505 tests green; merging, non-merging and round-trip pinned by byte tests
Task 'coda-ties' completed successfully.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add a slapback delay for WAVs

impact_assessment.why: echo-to feeds back repeatedly and chorus modulates its delay, with no single clean delayed copy for a classic slapback.
impact_assessment.benefits: slapback mixes one fixed delayed copy into the dry signal with a wet level; zero delay or zero mix is byte-identical.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: delay non-negative and rounded to frames, mix 0..1, zero delay/mix identity, deterministic, bounded, length and rate preserved, invalid WAVs fail; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for identity, single tap, determinism and bounds, a CLI command with --slap-delay/--slap-mix, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 510 tests green; single-tap, identity cases and bounds pinned by byte tests
Task 'coda-slapback' completed successfully.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add circular frame rotation for WAVs

impact_assessment.why: reverse-region and splice move or reverse frames, but no tool rotates a WAV circularly so the tail wraps to the front.
impact_assessment.benefits: rotate shifts every frame by a rounded frame offset with wraparound, preserving length, rate and all audio bytes.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: offset rounded to frames, wraparound exact, length and rate preserved, zero offset identity, invalid WAVs fail; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for wraparound, identity, length and validation, a CLI command with --rotate-by, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 515 tests green; wraparound, identity and length preservation pinned by byte tests
Task 'coda-rotate' completed successfully.
